items.question: What percentage reduction in food loss and waste does the UAE's Ne'ma National Food Loss and Waste initiative aim to achieve by 2030?
items.fact: Ne'ma targets 50 percent food waste reduction by 2030

items.question: How much money in AED does each Saned card provide to beneficiary families under the Saned charitable endowment initiative?
items.fact: Saned cards give beneficiary families AED 1,000 each
